name: motion
purpose: Temporal anti-aliasing: high-contrast thin things (a fence of 60 posts and two rails, a wire, poles at three depths) and moving ones (a bar orbiting, a cross turning, a block going to and fro, a ball and a pole sliding in front of the fence), posed by the frame's time. 'still' keeps the camera, 'pan' slides it sideways, 'close' looks at the fence from near. Judged against a supersampled still of the same moment (kin_reference --supersample 4), not Cycles: only the camera and the moving things change from one frame to the next.
